title: swetest: remaining modes + integration polish
description:
Wire up the remaining computation modes that aren't part of the main planet loop or special events, plus end-to-end integration testing.

**Differential/midpoint mode** (`-d`, `-D`, `-dh`, swetest.c lines 1685-1820):
- `-dX`: compute body X, subtract from each body in `-p` list → print difference
- `-DX`: same but print midpoint instead of difference
- `-dhX`: heliocentric body X vs geocentric bodies in `-p` — shows geo/helio divergence
- Implementation: compute the reference body separately, then for each body in the list, subtract/average position arrays before passing to the format engine

**Ayanamsa-only output** (`-ay`, swetest.c lines 1582-1590):
- When `-ay` is set without `-sid`, compute and print ayanamsha value for each timestep
- Uses `Ephemeris::get_ayanamsa_ex`
- Bypasses the normal body loop entirely

**House cusp output** (`-house`, swetest.c lines 1568-1579, 1637-1682):
- When `-house[lon,lat,sys]` is set and `-ut` is given
- Call `Ephemeris::houses_ex2` to get 12/36 cusps + AscMc
- Print cusps and special points (Asc, MC, ARMC, Vertex, etc.)
- Requires UT time input (C prints error otherwise)

**Output time modes**:
- `-lmt`: output times as Local Mean Time (subtract geopos[0]/15/24 from UT)
- `-lat`: output times as Local Apparent Time (via `Ephemeris::lmt_to_lat`)

**Misc flags**:
- `-bwd`: backward search direction (negate step, set search direction)
- `-lim`: print ephemeris file date range (via `Ephemeris::get_file_data` or similar)
- `-tidacc`: override tidal acceleration
- `-testaa95`/`-testaa96`/`-testaa97`: preset test configurations
- `-clink`: chart link output
- `-amod`: astro model overrides

**Integration testing**: Run a set of representative commands through both C swetest and Rust swetest, compare output visually. Document any known formatting differences. Candidate comparison commands:
- `swetest -b1.1.2000 -p0123456789 -fPLBRS -emos`
- `swetest -b1.1.2000 -p0 -sid1 -fPZBRS`
- `swetest -b1.1.2000 -house8.55,47.37,P -ut12`
- `swetest -b1.1.2000 -p0 -d1 -fPlBRS -n30`
- `swetest -b1.1.2000 -solecl -n1`
- `swetest -b1.1.2000 -rise -p0 -geopos8.55,47.37,500`

acceptance_criteria.text: swetest -ay1 -b1.1.2000 -n12 -s1y prints Lahiri ayanamsha for 12 years
At least 3 representative commands produce output comparable to C swetest (visually similar, numerically matching)

implementation_plan:
5 waves implemented:

1. **Ayanamsa-only (-ay)**: Short-circuit in run() bypasses planet loop, routes through format engine with is_ayanamsa suppression (no speed/lat/dist/cartesian). Extracted sidereal_mode_name helper.

2. **House cusps (-house)**: print_houses() after body loop calls eph.houses_ex2(), prints 12/36 cusps + 8 AscMc special points through format engine with is_house suppression. UT gate clears do_houses if !is_ut. Fixed ALLOW_361 in DMS speed formatting (cusp speeds >360 deg/day were clamped to 0).

3. **Differential/midpoint (-d/-D/-dh)**: apply_diff helper applies diff_degrees/midpoint_degrees to longitude (circular) and plain subtract/average to other components across all coordinate arrays. Modifies body name to 3-char truncated form.

4. **LMT header**: Shows LMT label + LMT JD line in header when time_mode==LMT.

5. **Horizontal output (-hor)**: is_first field on FormatContext suppresses time chars (yYJTt) for non-first bodies. print!/println! switching for horizontal vs normal mode.

Not implemented: -lim (file limits), -amod (astro models string wiring).

All values match C swetest numerically. Remaining diff is cosmetic (name column width, header format).
execution_record:
Implemented in 5 commits on main, 5 waves:

1. bec2bdd — ayanamsa-only output + is_house format suppression
2. 8c3cb75 — house cusp output + is_house/is_ayanamsa flag split + ALLOW_361 speed fix
3. d6b687a — differential/midpoint mode (-d/-D/-dh)
4. 88acebd — LMT/LAT header labels
5. c370167 — horizontal output mode (-hor)

All 7 acceptance criteria verified against C swetest — numerical values match exactly, only cosmetic differences (name column width padding, header format). All 130 unit tests + 187 golden tests pass.

Skipped -lim (file limits, not in acceptance criteria) and -amod (astro model string wiring, separate task). The ALLOW_361 DMS speed fix was an unexpected discovery — cusp speeds >360 deg/day were being clamped to 0 by the dms() function's normalize guard. Fixed by passing ALLOW_361 flag for all speed DMS calls in format_speed.

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Note from swisseph-rs/147: the `-hor` horizontal listing mode (all planets on one line, skip repeated time columns for non-first bodies) was deferred here. It changes the outer loop structure in compute.rs's `run()`, not the format engine itself — the format_line already handles individual bodies correctly, but -hor needs the run() loop to suppress newlines between bodies and skip time columns (yYJTt) for is_first=false. See C swetest.c:2102-2108 for the format-level skips and swetest.c:1921-1925 for the outer-loop newline logic.
